这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的 Flux.2 Klein 9B GGUF 简单完美的快速换头工作流程集，它将使用非常简单的自然语言文本编辑指令，从参考图像中交换所需目标图像主题的头部。我使用的 Q4 型号与我的 8GB AMD GPU 配合良好。但是如果你有更好的 GPU，你可以简单地用完全未量化的 Flux.2 Klein 9B 模型交换模型，或者在另一边，如果你有较弱的 GPU，你可以从这里找到其他非常低档的硬件（具有 2GB 或 4GB VRAM）支持的 GGUF 模型 - （ Unsloth 的 HuggingFace repo for Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF 模型 -https://huggingface.co/unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-4B-GGUF/tree/main）以及您可以在我的旧版 Flux.2 Klein 4B 的 Headswap 工作流程中使用的其他匹配资源。该工作流程集使用来自 NRDX 的 Best Face Swap (BFS) LORA for Flux.2 Klein 9B (https://civitai.com/user/NRDX ).

此工作流程集可以将您的换头生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。该工作流程集有两个文件 - Flux2k_9B_GGUF_SWAP_v1（默认尺寸）.json 是简单的修复和 Headswap 工作流程，Flux2k_9B_GGUF_SWAP_v1（自定义尺寸）.json 是具有修复工作流程的 Headswap。您将找到它使用具有此工作流程集的存档 (.Zip) 内的图像生成的所有已保存的提示文件。此外，通过使用 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将工作流程本身嵌入到每个保存的图像中，或者单独保存工作的图像和工作流程。

Flux.2 Klein 4B 和 9B 型号是高速 AI 图像生成器的新系列，它使用“整流流”架构将图像生成和专业级编辑统一到一个紧凑的软件包中。这些模型比旧版本要快得多，因为它们使用“逐步蒸馏”，这使得它们只需 4 个步骤即可创建高质量图像 - 在现代硬件上实现亚秒级速度 - 而不是以前模型所需的数十个步骤。 4B 变体是在允许个人和商业用途的 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布的，而功能更强大的 9B 变体则使用旨在用于研究和个人项目的非商业许可证。两种型号均支持 11 种原生宽高比，范围从 1:1 方形到 21:9 超宽和 9:21 垂直，并且可以生成高达 4 兆像素的清晰图像（例如 2048x2048）。为了让他们更加 易于访问，有 Q（量化）模型，如 FP8（8 位）和 NVFP4（4 位）版本，可减少模型的“大脑大小”以节省内存；具体来说，FP8 版本的速度提高了约 1.6 倍，并且使用的 VRAM 减少了 40%，而 NVFP4 版本的速度提高了 2.7 倍，并且使用的 VRAM 减少了 55%。虽然您可以在低至 2GB VRAM 的系统上运行 Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF 模型以顺利运行 Flux.2 Klein GGUF 模型，但您至少需要 6GB VRAM（即 Q4 GGUF，非常低端的 Q2 和 Q3 GGUF moel 文件无法产生高质量的结果，如果您有具有 2GB 或 4GB VRAM 的非常低端系统，那么您应该使用 Klein 4B GGUF 型号）。我使用了 Q4_K_M 文件，该文件与此工作流程集中的 6 或 8GB VRAM 配合良好。这提供了可接受的质量 结果。

您可以从 HuggingFace 下载此工作流程集中使用的所有必需模型文件（详细信息如下所述）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何必要节点，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、Pony、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、NoobAI、Illustrious、Lumina2、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 4B、Flux.1 Dev 和 Kandinsky Image 5 Lite 的其他工作流程（T2I 和 I2I）型号。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需首先选择您想要的 Flux.2 Klein 9B GGUF（或将其替换为完整型号）型号即可

#2.现在选择您的图像 - 用于面部交换的目标图像和您希望在输出中看到的参考面部图像

＃3。在下一步中，仅在必要时输入图像编辑说明。默认提示即可完成此工作

＃4。然后选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。之后选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置（您可能想保留默认值）

＃5。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

**这将自动检测拍摄对象的脸部和头发，在上面戴上面具，只修复那些部分，使图像的其余部分保持原样。布料、背景、姿势将保持不变，只有头部会被交换。当然，除非您指定要更改原始图像的哪些其他部分（请参阅名为 Output-2 和 Output-4 的示例以获取有关如何准确执行此操作的想法。是的！您可以对 NSFW 图像进行换头）

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Flux.2 Klein 9B GGUF Simple Flawless Fast Headswap Workflow set that will work with very simple text editing instructions in natural language to swap head of your desired target image's subject from a reference image. I used a Q4 Model that works well with my 8GB AMD GPU. But is you have better GPU you can simply swap the model with full unquantized Flux.2 Klein 9B model or on the other side if you have a weaker GPU you can find other very low grade hardware (with 2GB or 4GB VRAM) supported GGUF models from here - ( Unsloth's HuggingFace repo for Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF models -https://huggingface.co/unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-4B-GGUF/tree/main) and other matching resources that you can use on my older Headswap workflow for Flux.2 Klein 4B. This workflow set uses Best Face Swap (BFS) LORA for Flux.2 Klein 9B from NRDX (https://civitai.com/user/NRDX ).

This workflow set can save your Headswap Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. This workflow set has two files - Flux2k_9B_GGUF_SWAP_v1 (Default Dimensions).json is your simple inpainting & Headswap workflow and Flux2k_9B_GGUF_SWAP_v1 (Custom Dimensions).json is your Headswap with outpainting workflow. You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has this workflow set. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used you may embed the workflow itself with each saved image or save the image and workflow for your work separately.

The Flux.2 Klein 4B and 9B models are a new family of high-speed AI image generators that use a "rectified flow" architecture to unify image generation and professional-grade editing into a single, compact package. These models are significantly faster than older versions because they use "step-distillation," which allows them to create high-quality images in just 4 steps—achieving sub-second speeds on modern hardware—rather than the dozens of steps required by previous models. The 4B variant is released under a permissive Apache 2.0 License for both personal and commercial use, while the more powerful 9B variant uses a Non-Commercial License intended for research and personal projects. Both models support 11 native aspect ratios ranging from 1:1 square to 21:9 ultrawide and 9:21 vertical, and they can produce sharp images up to 4 megapixels (such as 2048x2048). To make them even more accessible, there are Q (Quantized) models like the FP8 (8-bit) and NVFP4 (4-bit) versions, which reduce the "brain size" of the model to save memory; specifically, the FP8 version is about 1.6x faster and uses 40% less VRAM, while the NVFP4 version is up to 2.7x faster and uses 55% less VRAM. While you can run the Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF model on systems with as low as 2GB VRAM to run Flux.2 Klein GGUF model smoothly you would need atleast 6GB VRAM (i.e. Q4 GGUF, the very low end Q2 & Q3 GGUF moel files can't produce quality results, if you have very low end systm with 2GB or 4GB VRAM then you should use Klein 4B GGUF models). I used Q4_K_M file that works well with 6 or 8GB VRAM in this workflow set. This one provide acceptable quality results.

You can download all of your necessary model files used in this workflow set from HuggingFace (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, Pony, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, NoobAI, Illustrious, Lumina2, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.2 Klein 4B, Flux.1 Dev and Kandinsky Image 5 Lite (T2I & I2I) models. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Flux.2 Klein 9B GGUF (or swap it with full model) models first and now

#2. now select your image(s) - a target image for face swap & a reference face image that you want to see on your output

#3. on next step enter your image editing instructions only if you have to.. the default prompt simply does the job

#4. then select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. after this select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings (you may wanna stay with defaults)

#5. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

**This will automatically detect subject's face and hair, put masks over these and only inpaint those portions leaving rest of image as it is.. cloth, background, postures will remain preserved only head will be swapped. Unless of course you specify which other part(s) of the original image you want to change ( See the Examples named Output-2 and Output-4 to get ideas about how to exactly do so.. and Yes! you can do headswaps for NSFW images )
